title: Execute the documented browser and central recovery

verify.summary: TASK-051 and TASK-049 runtime evidence is deferred until a real server exists. TASK-056 remains planned for that later recovery-evidence phase and is not a current queue blocker.
verify.resume_route: when the real server exists, resume TASK-056 through its existing recovery evidence route

evidence_required: FT-003-AC-013 RED: no retained execution proves the documented recovery; GREEN: an authorized SSH operator follows only the runbook from managed Chromium failure and ordinary intact-volume central restart, restoring role readiness, automatic reachable-origin reload, advertising with retained central credential/discarded personalized state, queued Photo progress and fresh admission, while retained records confirm no-offline-start and sole-primary-loss limits; decisive comparison: each precondition/step/success check maps to redacted evidence and no destructive or permission-expanding action; artifact: reports/logs under .tasks/TASK-056-T3-FT-003-W6/.
purpose: Execute, not redesign, the bounded operator recovery procedure and retain its evidence.
success_outcome: The documented browser and intact-volume central restart procedures are reproducible under the accepted limits.
anti_goals: Do not improvise credential, migration, volume, browser-flag or serving-setting repair.
Do not claim offline startup or sole-primary-loss recovery.
Do not change runtime behavior beyond a truthful in-scope runbook wording repair.

forbidden_scope: Implementation of SSH, kiosk service and central check owned by prerequisite tasks
stop_conditions: A runbook step fails or needs an undocumented action.
A volume is missing, migration ancestry invalid or role cannot become ready.
Evidence requires disclosure or a destructive action.

constraints: Follow only documented steps on the pilot host and stop on any required deviation.
Retain redacted checks and service/Compose state under the task directory.
Restart only named application roles/edge with intact configured volumes.
invariants: Recovery authorizes restart and observation only.
Evidence never claims offline start or primary-loss recovery.
Intact-volume state and configured central credential remain preserved.
verification_targets: FT-003-AC-013 browser and central procedure evidence.
Review of limits and absence of destructive/permission-expanding steps.
